tools.name: describe_form
tools.description: Describe the form on the current page: which fields it has, which are required, and what each one accepts. Use it to help a person fill the form in. It cannot submit — the person submits the form themselves.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one page on forumone.com by its path, e.g. /insights/blog/ai-search-impact-nonprofits. Use search_content first if you do not already have the path.

path.description: The site-relative path, starting with a slash. Not a full URL.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Forum One's published articles, case studies, reports, events, capabilities and open roles. Returns titles, URLs and summaries. Use this before fetching a page, to find which page to fetch.

query.description: Words to search for in titles and summaries, e.g. "AI strategy nonprofits".

collection.description: Restrict the search to one kind of content. Omit to search all of them.
